name: TraceSignals Conversion Tracking
author: tracesignals

sections.description:
TraceSignals is the ultimate marketing and conversion tracking plugin for WooCommerce. Track every step of your buyer journey across GA4, Google Ads, and Meta (Facebook) Pixel — with no code changes — and attribute the traffic AI assistants send to your store.

Why store owners install TraceSignals

  • GA4 Enhanced Ecommerce — product views, add to cart, begin checkout, and purchases sent as proper GA4 events. Struggling with missing purchases? See our guide on setting up GA4 purchase tracking on WooCommerce.
  • Google Ads Enhanced Conversions — customer data is securely hashed before transmission, improving match rates without compromising privacy.
  • Meta (Facebook) Pixel — full-funnel WooCommerce events. If your Pixel reports fewer conversions than your store does, here’s why that happens.
  • AI Referral Engine — proprietary attribution for visitors arriving from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. Learn more about AI citation for ecommerce.
  • Lightweight — asynchronous script loading with no measurable impact on page speed.

Learn more

  • Full feature list
  • Pricing
  • Conversion tracking guides on our blog
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google Analytics or Meta account?

Yes — TraceSignals sends data to your own GA4, Google Ads, and Meta accounts. You keep full ownership of your data.

Is this GDPR / CCPA compliant?

TraceSignals hashes customer data before transmission where supported. Compliance with regional privacy law (consent banners, disclosures) remains the site owner’s responsibility.

Will it slow down my store?

No. All tracking scripts load asynchronously and are deferred until after page render.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes — WooCommerce is our primary integration, covering the complete funnel from product view to purchase.

Where can I get support or documentation?

Visit tracesignals.io or use the wordpress.org support forum for this plugin.
